race.comment: WOOTTEN HYDE (5) returns and will get a pleasant surprise when he looks around the mounting yard. Didn't fire in the LR Daybreak Lover before the break but his prior efforts behind Fabulantes read strongly for this CL1 and his recent trial suggests he's come back in good order. Similarly, WARREGO RIVER (12) also resumes from a rearward finish stakes company. Was a determined maiden winner in heavy going at Ipswich to kickoff last campaign, so she shouldn't be bothered by a wet deck, and her two trials in have been strong. FROSTNIP (7) makes her stable debut for the Dunn camp and shoulders some solid Victorian benchmark form. Has been readied with two strong trial performances and is among the main hopes. CONFORMITY (6) only warmed late when resuming at Doomben. Better for that and should take closer order second-up from the inside alley.
